intro: Concentrates are the smallest smokable category on New York menus, with about 1,320 listings across the 67 licensed dispensaries we track, from 112 brands. The term covers everything extracted from flower and meant for a dab rig or vaporizer: live resin, live rosin, budder, cured resin, diamonds, hash and RSO syringes. MFNY dominates with 205 listings, more than the next three brands combined, followed by RYTHM and Hudson Cannabis at 79 each, Olio at 73, Static Room at 59 and Umamii at 54.

Prices start at $20, with most grams between $30 and $65 before tax depending on the extraction. Solventless live rosin from brands like A1 Ducksauce sits at the top of that range; cured resin and budder sit near the bottom. Midtown has by far the deepest selection at 184 listings, led by Qube's 70-item case, with Sheepshead Bay at 129, Chelsea and Flatiron at 127 and Bushwick at 99. Most shops carry only a handful, so if you dab regularly, the large Midtown and south Brooklyn menus are where to look.
know: About 1,320 listings from 112 brands across 67 shops; the smallest inhalable category.
MFNY has 205 listings, more than RYTHM, Hudson Cannabis and Olio combined.
Prices start at $20; most grams are $30 to $65, with solventless rosin at the top.
Deepest neighborhoods: Midtown (184), Sheepshead Bay (129), Chelsea and Flatiron (127), Bushwick (99).

faq.q: What is the difference between live resin and live rosin?
faq.a: Both start with flower frozen at harvest. Live resin is extracted with a solvent like butane, then purged; live rosin uses only ice water, heat and pressure. Rosin costs more and is sold by brands like A1 Ducksauce; MFNY and Olio are the main live resin makers in New York.

faq.q: How much concentrate can I buy?
faq.a: New York's possession limit is 24 grams of concentrate, separate from the three-ounce flower limit. Dispensaries sell single grams and occasionally half-grams, so the limit rarely matters in practice.

faq.q: Which dispensary has the most concentrates?
faq.a: Qube in Midtown, with about 70 listings. Gotham Chelsea, Culture House, Buzzy in Brooklyn Heights and Grams in Williamsburg each carry cases of 23 to 30.

intro: Edibles are the second-largest category on New York menus, with about 8,090 listings across the 69 licensed dispensaries we track, from 242 brands. The category runs from single 10-milligram drinks and two-pack tablets through gummies, chocolate, cookies and tinctures-in-disguise like shots, and it is where most of the city's lowest-priced products live. Ayrloom leads with 618 listings, followed by Camino at 595, Grön at 590, Wyld at 530, Off Hours at 455, 1906 at 274, MFNY at 257 and Eaton Botanicals at 251.

Prices start at $2.26, and 1906 drop pouches and Ayrloom single-serve drinks at $3 to $6 are the entry item at most shops. Standard 10-count gummy packs run $17 to $30 and 100-milligram chocolate bars about $25 before tax. Midtown has the deepest edible selection at about 1,120 listings, then Chelsea and Flatiron at 748, the Villages at 611, Sheepshead Bay at 461, Williamsburg at 442 and SoHo at 433, the only Manhattan neighborhood where edibles outnumber every other category. New York caps edibles at 10 milligrams of THC per serving and 100 milligrams per package, so a 20-count pack is 5 milligrams per piece.
know: About 8,090 listings from 242 brands across 69 shops; the second-largest category.
Ayrloom, Camino, Grön, Wyld and Off Hours each have 450 or more listings.
Prices start at $2.26; drinks and drop pouches at $3 to $6 are the common entry item; 10-packs run $17 to $30.
New York caps edibles at 10 milligrams THC per serving and 100 milligrams per package.

faq.q: How long do edibles take to work?
faq.a: Gummies and chocolate typically take 30 minutes to two hours, since THC is absorbed through digestion. Drinks from brands like Layup and Ayrloom use water-soluble THC and many people feel them in 15 to 30 minutes. Start with 5 milligrams or less if you are new.

faq.q: What is the cheapest edible in New York City?
faq.a: In our data, 1906 drop pouches are the floor, listed at $3 at Qube in Midtown and $3.10 to $3.50 at Purple Buds, Verdi Park Slope and Alta. Ayrloom and Layup single-serve drinks at $5 are the most common cheap item citywide.

faq.q: Are cannabis drinks sold at every dispensary?
faq.a: Nearly. Ayrloom is carried at 63 of the 67 shops we track, and most of them stock its single-serve 2:1 drinks. Layup, Tune, Weed Water, High Peaks, Harney Brothers and Cycling Frog are the other common drink brands.

intro: Flower is the third-largest category on New York menus, with about 6,780 listings across the 68 licensed dispensaries we track, from 457 brands, the longest brand list of any category. That number reflects how many small New York growers sell packaged eighths through licensed shops. The biggest flower brands are Grassroots at 228 listings, Dank By Definition at 217, To The Moon at 206, Find. at 190, RYTHM at 140, Boukét at 138, Doobie Labs at 137 and Runtz at 132.

Prices start at $8.85 for 5 Boro's 0.7-gram dime bags, the cheapest way to try loose flower in the city, while eighths run $18 to $50 before tax and craft indoor brands like 1Slice and 167 Exotics sit at the top. Midtown has the deepest selection at 723 listings, driven by Qube's 387-item wall, followed by the Villages at 469, Sheepshead Bay at 460, Chelsea and Flatiron at 430, the Upper West Side at 405 and Astoria at 401. A few shops are flower-first against the Manhattan trend: Broadway Strains in Washington Heights, By Any Other Name in Clinton Hill and Twisted Vibrations in Williamsburg all list more flower than anything else.
know: About 6,780 listings from 457 brands across 68 shops; the most brands of any category.
Grassroots, Dank By Definition, To The Moon and Find. each have 190 or more listings.

Deepest neighborhoods: Midtown (723), the Villages (469), Sheepshead Bay (460), Chelsea (430).

faq.q: What is a dime bag on New York menus?
faq.a: A small 0.7-gram bag of flower, sold by 5 Boro and a few other brands for $9 to $12 before tax. It is enough for one or two joints and the cheapest way to try a strain before committing to an eighth.

faq.q: How much flower can I buy at once?
faq.a: New York's adult possession limit is three ounces. Most shops sell eighths, quarters and some half-ounces and ounces, and Dank By Definition lists 28-gram bags at some stores. The limit is per person, not per transaction.

faq.q: Which dispensary has the biggest flower selection?
faq.a: Qube in Midtown, with about 387 flower listings. Outside Midtown, Broadway Strains in Washington Heights at 146 and the large Sheepshead Bay and Astoria shops have the deepest walls.

intro: Pre-rolls are the single largest category on New York menus, with about 9,990 listings across the 67 licensed dispensaries we track, from 456 brands. The format ranges from 0.5-gram singles and mini multi-packs to infused joints and blunts, and it is the easiest way to buy flower without a grinder or papers. Ruby Farms leads with 752 listings, far ahead of Dank By Definition at 304, Florist Farms at 280, Jeeter at 277, Anthem at 248, Dogwalkers at 227, Claybourne Co. at 211 and STIIIZY at 200.

Prices start at $5.31, with uninfused singles typically $9 to $15 before tax, infused singles $16 to $25, and multi-packs like Ruby Farms' seven-pack Doobies around $38. Midtown has the deepest selection at about 1,216 listings, led by Qube's 650, then Chelsea and Flatiron at 853, the Villages at 754, Sheepshead Bay at 654, the Upper West Side at 555 and Williamsburg at 504. In Queens, ENFLOR in Jackson Heights and Terp Bros in Astoria carry the largest pre-roll menus; in Brooklyn, Happy Buds in Bed-Stuy is the most pre-roll-focused shop with 153 of its 371 listings.
know: About 9,990 listings from 456 brands across 67 shops; the largest category in the city.
Ruby Farms has 752 listings, more than twice the next brand; Dank By Definition, Florist Farms and Jeeter follow.
Prices start at $5.31; uninfused singles run $9 to $15, infused $16 to $25, seven-packs about $38.
Deepest neighborhoods: Midtown (1,216), Chelsea and Flatiron (853), the Villages (754), Sheepshead Bay (654).

faq.q: What is an infused pre-roll?
faq.a: A joint with concentrate added, usually live resin, kief or diamonds, which raises potency well above plain flower. Florist Farms, Jeeter and Alibi are common infused brands in New York, with singles around $16 to $25 before tax.

faq.q: What are the cheapest pre-rolls in New York?
faq.a: In our data the floor is $5.31, and uninfused singles from 5 Boro, Juan Roll and Nanticoke run $9 to $10 at many shops. Dank By Definition lists singles from $7.50 at Cannavita in Astoria.

faq.q: Which dispensary has the most pre-rolls?
faq.a: Qube in Midtown, with about 650 listings. Twenty8gramz in Sheepshead Bay, Stash Master in Bushwick and The Flowery Upper West Side are the deepest outside Midtown.

intro: Tinctures are a small category on New York menus, with about 445 listings across the 62 licensed dispensaries we track, from 41 brands. A tincture is cannabis extract in a carrier oil, dosed by the dropper under the tongue, which acts faster than a gummy and lets you measure doses precisely. Ayrloom leads with 123 listings, followed by MFNY at 88 with its live resin tinctures, Head & Heal at 83, Papa & Barkley at 32, Ithaca Organics at 12 and Harney Brothers at 10.

Prices start at $7.08, with Ayrloom's low-dose everyday drops at $15 and most 15- to 30-milliliter bottles between $28 and $50 before tax. High-CBD ratios like Ayrloom's 1:3 THC-to-CBD and sleep formulas with CBN are common. Midtown has the deepest selection at 57 listings, then Chelsea and Flatiron at 42, SoHo at 27, the Villages at 26, Gramercy at 25 and Brooklyn Heights at 24. Most shops carry three to ten tinctures; Verdi Chelsea, ENFLOR and Gotham Chelsea are among the deeper individual shelves at 11 to 14.
know: About 445 listings from 41 brands across 62 shops.
Ayrloom (123), MFNY (88) and Head & Heal (83) account for two-thirds of the category.
Prices start at $7.08; most bottles are $28 to $50 before tax.
Deepest neighborhoods: Midtown (57), Chelsea and Flatiron (42), SoHo (27).

faq.q: How do I use a cannabis tincture?
faq.a: Measure a dose with the dropper, hold it under your tongue for 30 to 60 seconds, then swallow. Onset is usually 15 to 45 minutes, faster than an edible, and the bottle label gives milligrams per dropper so you can start small.

faq.q: Are there CBD-heavy tinctures?
faq.a: Yes. Ayrloom's low-dose everyday drops are 1:3 THC to CBD, and Head & Heal and Papa & Barkley make high-CBD ratios too. These are common choices for people who want minimal intoxication.

faq.q: Which dispensary has the most tinctures?
faq.a: ENFLOR in Jackson Heights lists 14 and Qube in Midtown 17, the deepest we track. Verdi Chelsea and Gotham Chelsea each carry 11.

intro: Topicals are the smallest category on New York menus, with about 260 listings across the 59 licensed dispensaries we track, from 24 brands. The category covers creams, balms, lotions, roll-ons and patches applied to the skin, usually for localized relief, and most are not intoxicating because THC absorbed through skin does not reach the bloodstream in meaningful amounts. Ayrloom leads with 101 listings, followed by Papa & Barkley at 59, Ruby Farms at 29, Head & Heal at 16, MFNY at 11 and The Healing Rose at 9.

Prices start at $6, with most full-size products between $30 and $55 before tax; Ayrloom's Revive 1:1 balm at 1,000 milligrams each of THC and CBD runs about $45 to $55 and is the most widely stocked item. Midtown has the deepest selection at 32 listings, SoHo is second at 30 thanks to Alta's 18-item shelf, the largest at any single shop, then Chelsea and Flatiron at 23 and Chinatown and Brooklyn Heights at 18 each. Most dispensaries carry only one to five topicals, so Alta is the place to compare several.
know: About 260 listings from 24 brands across 59 shops; the smallest category.
Ayrloom (101) and Papa & Barkley (59) make up more than half the category.
Prices start at $6; most full-size balms and lotions are $30 to $55 before tax.
Alta in SoHo has 18 topicals, the most of any shop; Midtown has the most overall at 32.

faq.q: Will a cannabis topical get me high?
faq.a: Lotions, balms and roll-ons generally will not, because THC does not pass through skin into the bloodstream in significant amounts. Transdermal patches are designed to, so check the label if that matters.

faq.q: What is Ayrloom Revive?
faq.a: A 1:1 topical with 1,000 milligrams each of THC and CBD, the most widely stocked topical in the city. It lists at about $45 to $55 before tax depending on the shop.

faq.q: Where can I compare several topicals in one place?
faq.a: Alta on Kenmare Street in SoHo, with 18 listings. Most other licensed shops carry fewer than five, so Alta is the only place to compare brands side by side.

intro: Vapes are the second-largest category on New York menus by a narrow margin, with about 8,870 listings across the 69 licensed dispensaries we track, from 245 brands. The category includes 510-thread cartridges, pod systems like PAX and Plug Play, and disposable all-in-ones in half-gram, one-gram, 1.5-gram and two-gram sizes. Jaunty leads with 626 listings, followed by STIIIZY at 574, Fernway at 572, Select at 404, Ayrloom at 403, MFNY at 376, Heavy Hitters at 372 and Rove at 370.

Prices start at $0.88, likely a battery or accessory, with half-gram disposables from about $25, one-gram cartridges $35 to $60 and premium all-in-ones from Fernway and Jetty $50 to $95 before tax. Midtown has by far the deepest selection at about 1,410 listings, led by Qube's 652, then Sheepshead Bay at 814, Chelsea and Flatiron at 784, the Villages at 478, the Upper West Side at 434 and Williamsburg at 407. Vapes are the top category in Midtown, Sheepshead Bay, Gramercy and Park Slope, and shops like Green Genius, Bud & Honey, Torches and The Flowery Brooklyn are built around them.
know: About 8,870 listings from 245 brands across 69 shops; nearly tied with edibles for second-largest category.
Jaunty, STIIIZY and Fernway each have more than 570 listings; Select, Ayrloom, MFNY, Heavy Hitters and Rove follow.
Half-gram disposables start around $25; one-gram cartridges run $35 to $60; premium all-in-ones $50 to $95.
Deepest neighborhoods: Midtown (1,410), Sheepshead Bay (814), Chelsea and Flatiron (784).

faq.q: What is the difference between a cartridge and an all-in-one?
faq.a: A cartridge screws onto a separate rechargeable 510-thread battery and can be swapped out. An all-in-one, or disposable, has the battery built in and is discarded when empty. Pod systems like PAX and Plug Play use proprietary pods with their own battery.

faq.q: Which vape brands are made in New York?
faq.a: Jaunty, MFNY, Ayrloom, Florist Farms and Off Hours are New York companies. STIIIZY, Fernway, Select, Heavy Hitters, Rove and Jetty are out-of-state brands produced in New York under license, as the law requires for licensed sale.

faq.q: Which dispensary has the most vapes?
faq.a: Qube in Midtown, with about 652 listings. Twenty8gramz and Quality Control in Sheepshead Bay, Stash Master in Bushwick and The Flowery Upper West Side are the deepest outside Midtown.
